title: Captain Suite event envelope v1
description: Envelope the CONSUMER (Workflow Captain core) builds from a provider's PHP action. Cores do not emit it. Normative text: docs/SPEC-suite-events.md, section 6.

id.description: UUID version 4, generated by the consumer when it stores the event.

spec_version.description: Version of this specification the envelope follows (MAJOR.MINOR).

product.description: Key (folder and text domain) of the plugin that fired the PHP action.

core_version.description: Plugin version of the provider at capture time.

contract_version.description: Value of <PREFIX>_CONTRACT_VERSION at capture time; null while the provider has no contract constant.

occurred_at.description: Moment the provider's action fired, UTC, RFC 3339 with the literal Z.

blog_id.description: get_current_blog_id() at capture time (1 on a single site).

id.description: Identifier of the subject as a string. Never a code, token, key or e-mail address.

id_kind.description: public = dedicated public identifier of the core; record = record number of the core, used only where the core has no public identifier (SPEC-open-questions.md, F-02).

actor_user_id.description: WordPress user ID connected with the event (see the per-type table for its meaning). Personal data.

data.description: Allow-listed scalar fields of the event type. Nested values are not allowed.

idempotency_key.description: SHA-256 (hex) over spec major, blog ID, type, subject and the per-type discriminator. Unique per site in the consumer's store.

correlation_id.description: Groups everything that belongs to one process. Equals id for an event that starts a chain.

causation_id.description: id of the command that caused this event, or null when no workflow caused it.

caused_by_workflow_id.description: ID of the workflow whose action caused this event. Required when causation_id is set.

chain_depth.description: 0 for an event no workflow caused; depth of the causing event plus 1 otherwise. Events above the limit are stored but start nothing.
